english.note: Choose this when the made-up thing is an invented story, character, or imaginary situation rather than simply a fake object.
Use this when “fabled” stresses that the person, place, or event is invented rather than merely legendary.

examples.english: This character is a make-up character from the novel.
examples.jyutping: ni1 go3 gok3 sik1 hai6 heoi1 kau3 ge3

examples.english: The fabled city in that novel doesn't exist in the real world.
